nodes.label: The unlocalized blog_categories table makes /id/ blog category pages emit English names and descriptions
nodes.norm_label: the unlocalized blog_categories table makes /id/ blog category pages emit english names and descriptions
nodes.rationale: Reused id: chunk-rem-081, chunk-rem-137, chunk-rem-148 and chunk-rem-153 reached the same claim from the fix sessions; this note names the unlocalized table as the root cause of the duplicate titles and stub descriptions. [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset-seo/2026-09-28 - t6-chunk-c02 [ses_f16e37da2ffeuYbSkBwKbkNwLy].md:L2315] `getCategoryBySlug()` and `getAllCategories()` in `apps/website/src/utils/d1-blog-api.ts:358,367` take no locale argument and `SELECT * FROM blog_categories` has no `language` filter, whereas `getPostsByCategory(db, slug, page, 'id')` and `getPopularPosts(db, 5, 'id')` on the very same page do filter `p.language = ?`. So the `/id/` category pages necessarily emit English `name` and `description`
